title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Lobby Directory. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Lobby Directory
options.thesis: The whole app reads like the directory board in the building where you're serving your apprenticeship: find your programme, find your event, find your people, by listing number.
options.viewport: A long backlit directory wall where each event is a routed listing row, numbered like a suite, with an amber LIVE tab for anything happening now.
options.risk: Reads like static signage if listings don't actually behave like a real directory (sliding, re-indexing, lit states).

raised.raise: Every attendee gets a small hand-set personal mark beside their name in the directory, not a generic avatar circle.
Each event carries a short directory-style code (like a suite number) as a secondary identifier next to its title.

options.label: The Logbook
options.thesis: The whole product as the binder of signed-off evidence every apprentice already keeps: events are entries, RSVPs are sign-offs, profiles are tabbed sections.
options.viewport: An open ring-binder spread: the left page is the events log, the right page is the cohort roster, both ruled and tab-indexed.
options.risk: Also the direction most apprentice-targeted products reach for first when asked to 'feel official.'

options.label: The Build Manual
options.thesis: Every event unlocks like the next step in your build — numbered, exploded, impossible to misplace.
options.case: Fuses well: programme milestones map cleanly onto numbered steps; loses narrowly on clarity because a flat browse-and-filter list resists a linear step sequence.
options.risk: Can read as a kids'-toy voice if the numerals and arrows aren't drawn with real precision.

options.label: The Signal Bench
options.thesis: Events are live signals on the bench; RSVP arms the trigger and locks the trace.
options.case: Fuses with real precision for engineering apprentices and dramatizes attendee count as trace amplitude; loses on clarity once content gets dense, since an all-signals-at-once screen fights a long filterable list.
options.risk: Reads as a developer in-joke to non-SDE programmes (data, cyber) unless the instrument metaphor gets translated past the surface.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: The catalog of events as giant live tiles you flip through, not cards you scroll past.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: tiles map one-to-one onto event cards and tags, and live-flip states read clearly; loses on audience identification since the reference reads as general design history rather than anything apprentice-specific.
options.risk: Reads like a dated OS skin unless the tiles carry real live data.

options.label: Signed Collective Plate
options.lineage: painted collective plates with shared symbol sets
options.case: Fuses poorly: an abstract painters'-collective language doesn't identify with an apprentice audience, and shared-symbol browsing doesn't clarify a dense event list.
options.kept: Personal signature marks per attendee, donated to the assigned direction.

options.label: Sneaker Box Archive
options.case: Fuses poorly: sneaker-collecting culture has no connection to apprenticeship or engineering programmes, and box-opening doesn't support filtering by date/location/tag.
options.kept: Directory-style listing codes per event, donated to the assigned direction.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean cards, soft shadows, a hero banner, rounded pills for tags — what every events app already looks like.
canonCard.viewport: A hero banner over a responsive card grid of events, filter pills along the top.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Eventbrite, Luma, or Meetup by design.
